state.product: MenteViva is a free, fully offline iOS collection of calm mini games, EN and ES, zero third-party dependencies. Older adults are the reference audience. Large controls, easy-to-name pictures, warm copy, and no medical claims remain requirements.
state.current_design: Card Table: framed game cards with distinct game colors, native serif headings and rounded system controls, shared game header and calm celebrations. Game content currently uses emoji or system symbols; a merged catalogue can resolve original illustrations incrementally.
state.approved_art_direction: The owner approved an original vintage rubber-hose cartoon and mid-century printed-card direction after viewing an eight-object concept sheet. Bold espresso outlines, fluid C/S curves, familiar silhouettes, restrained exaggeration, selective friendly faces, and limited flat colors. No copied characters, poses, compositions, source images, logos, or named-artist prompts. Production pictures must be simpler and cleaner than presentation art, transparent 600x600 PNG under 120 KB, at most four flat fills, no fine grain at small tile sizes.
state.palette: Cream FFF1D0, espresso 2B2118, dark tomato AF3F32, honey mustard E7AC45, muted jade 246456, faded blue 35566D. Calculated sRGB text contrast on cream: espresso14.06, tomato5.24, jade6.18, blue6.93. Mustard is an accent fill with espresso text (7.79), not text on cream (1.81). Dark surround211E1B with cream text14.80. Actual screens still need verification.
state.validation: Pictures are reviewed in complete game sets, in grayscale and on actual light/dark tile backgrounds. Include 100pt and actual rendered sizes: category game52pt; memory pictures half the shorter card side. Same image in both appearances. All localization, VoiceOver, touch-target, Reduce Motion, original-content provenance and legal-review requirements remain.
state.rollout: One shared style sheet and fixed prompt template for all four illustration batches, with the approved concept attached to the epic and tickets. Catalogue already merged. Style direction is approved; individual samples, provenance and technical checks are still pending. Assets stay separate from Swift app styling. Proposed later app work: apply coherent palette, outlines, headings and calm feedback to existing screens without navigation changes; evolve existing card-based app icon and wordmark after small-size studies, rather than replace brand recognition.

art_fit.instructions: Assess the proposed original retro illustration direction for adult-friendly calm games and small-picture recognition. This is evidence, not legal clearance or a substitute for owner approval.

faces_policy.instructions: Which face policy best balances charm, object recognition, maturity and avoiding a collection of similar-looking mascots?

criteria.selective: Occasional subtle faces, with object silhouette always primary

app_alignment.instructions: Choose a scope that achieves visual coherence while protecting accessibility and release progress.

criteria.styling_only: Retune colors, outlines, native typography and calm feedback in existing layouts; icon evolves in a separate small-size study
criteria.assets_only: Ship pictures with no app palette or icon work
criteria.full_redesign: Rebuild navigation, screens, branding and game layouts together
